levels.title: Before you share the message
levels.word: claim · verify · credible · misleading · reveal · deny
levels.description: Six words, two kinds of practice, and one complete reading.

paragraphs.en: A message in a neighborhood group makes a dramatic claim: the local bridge will close for six months. It includes a photograph of a real notice, which makes the message appear credible. However, the photograph cuts off the date and the name of the bridge.
paragraphs.zh: 邻里群中的一条消息提出了惊人说法：当地大桥将关闭六个月。消息附了一张真实通知的照片，因此看起来可信。然而，照片裁去了日期和桥名。

paragraphs.en: Ravi decides to verify the details before sharing it. The complete notice concerns repairs at another bridge two years earlier. The photograph itself is genuine, but using it without the missing information is misleading. Something can be real and still support a false impression.
paragraphs.zh: 拉维决定在转发前核实细节。完整通知说的是两年前另一座桥的维修。照片本身是真的，但省略那些信息来使用它会误导人。真实的材料仍可能造成错误印象。

paragraphs.en: The council does not deny that the local bridge needs maintenance; it explains that only one lane will close for a weekend. That detail helps reveal why a simple true-or-false label is not enough. Readers must check what is actually being asserted, what the evidence shows, and what has been left out.
paragraphs.zh: 委员会没有否认当地大桥需要保养，而是解释说，只会在一个周末关闭一条车道。这一细节揭示了为什么简单贴上真假标签并不足够。读者需要核对消息究竟声称什么、证据表明什么，以及遗漏了什么。

levels.title: A garden for the island
levels.word: habitat · diverse · invasive · preserve · decline · recover
levels.description: Six words, two kinds of practice, and one complete reading.

paragraphs.en: An island school turns an unused field into a garden. The students hope to create a habitat for local insects, but they first choose plants only for their bright colors. A scientist asks them to look beyond appearance and consider which plants support a diverse community of local species.
paragraphs.zh: 一所岛屿学校把闲置空地改成花园。学生希望给当地昆虫创造栖息地，但最初只按鲜艳颜色选择植物。一位科学家请他们不只看外观，还要考虑哪些植物能支持多样的本地物种群落。

paragraphs.en: One fast-growing plant spreads beyond its bed and crowds out slower plants. The scientist describes it as invasive in this setting, not merely successful in a pot. To preserve the garden’s variety, the students remove it carefully and replace it with plants better suited to the site.
paragraphs.zh: 一种生长迅速的植物越过花坛，挤占生长较慢植物的空间。科学家解释说，在这个环境里它具有入侵性，而不仅是在花盆中长得好。为保护花园的多样性，学生小心移除它，换上更适合此地的植物。

paragraphs.en: The number of visiting insects continues to decline during a dry month. After rain returns, some populations recover, but the students resist declaring the project a total success or failure after a single count. They keep records across seasons because a living system does not respond to every change immediately.
paragraphs.zh: 一个干燥月份里，来访昆虫的数量继续下降。降雨恢复后，一些种群开始恢复，但学生没有根据一次统计就宣布项目彻底成功或失败。他们持续记录不同季节，因为生态系统并不会对每种变化都立刻作出反应。

levels.description: Six words, two kinds of practice, and one complete reading.

paragraphs.en: A college has enough money for five scholarships. To be eligible, applicants must meet a clear set of criteria, including enrollment and financial need. Meeting those requirements allows a student to be considered; it does not guarantee an award.
paragraphs.zh: 一所学院的资金足够提供五份奖学金。申请者要具备资格，必须满足明确条件，包括在读状态和经济需要。达到要求意味着可以进入评选，而不保证获奖。

paragraphs.en: The committee debates how to recognize merit. Some applicants have impressive grades; others show potential despite working long hours outside school. An identical rule for every person may look fair while overlooking differences in opportunity. The committee wants a process that is equitable as well as understandable.
paragraphs.zh: 委员会讨论如何衡量优秀之处。有些申请人成绩出色，另一些虽课外长时间工作，仍表现出潜力。对所有人套用同一规则看似公平，却可能忽视机会差异。委员会希望流程既公正，又容易理解。

paragraphs.en: It publishes its scoring approach before reviewing applications and records why it chooses to allocate each award. Students who are not selected receive a short explanation. A limited budget cannot remove every disappointment, but clear reasons allow people to question the process rather than guess at hidden preferences.
paragraphs.zh: 委员会在审核申请前公布评分方式，并记录每份奖学金的分配理由。未入选的学生会收到简短说明。有限预算无法消除所有失望，但明确理由能让人们对流程提出质询，而非猜测隐秘偏好。

article.title: What does a survey really say?

paragraphs.en: A student newspaper asks readers whether the library should stay open later. Most replies support the change, but the sample comes from a late-night study group. The editor asks whether those responses can represent everyone who uses the library.
paragraphs.zh: 学生报询问读者是否希望图书馆延长开放时间。大多数回复支持，但样本来自一个夜间学习群体。编辑提出，这些回复能否代表所有图书馆使用者？

paragraphs.en: For a second survey, the students invite a random selection of users from the membership list. They report the proportion in favor, rather than only the number of supportive messages. They also state how many people did not respond, since a large invitation list does not guarantee a balanced set of replies.
paragraphs.zh: 第二次调查中，学生从会员名单中随机邀请部分使用者。他们报告支持者所占比例，而不只报告支持消息数量。他们也说明未回复人数，因为邀请名单很长，并不能保证回复构成均衡。

paragraphs.en: The final article discusses the margin of uncertainty around its estimate. It does not infer that every user wants the same timetable. The survey informs a decision alongside staffing costs and safety needs; it is useful evidence, not a way to make every other consideration disappear.
paragraphs.zh: 最终文章讨论了估计值的不确定范围，并没有推断每位使用者都想要同一种时间表。调查与人员成本、安全需要一起为决定提供参考；它是有用证据，而不是消除其他所有考虑的手段。

paragraphs.en: After reading a vocabulary list, Jo can recognize every word but cannot recall many of them the next day. Recognition provides a feeling of familiarity, while producing a word without seeing it is a different task. Jo decides to change how she reviews.
paragraphs.zh: 读完一份词表后，乔能认出每个词，但第二天无法主动想起其中许多词。识别会带来熟悉感，而不看词就主动说出它，是另一种任务。乔决定改变复习方法。

paragraphs.en: She tries to associate each new word with a useful scene, then closes the page and attempts to retrieve it. When she cannot, she checks the answer and tries again later. The interval between attempts grows gradually instead of filling one evening with the same easy repetition.
paragraphs.zh: 她尝试把每个新词与实用场景联系起来，然后关上页面，努力提取这个词。想不起来时，她查看答案，稍后再试。两次尝试之间的间隔逐渐拉长，而不再用同样简单的重复占满一个晚上。

paragraphs.en: Jo also compares similar words to distinguish their uses. Examples help reinforce a connection, but she does not treat one successful answer as a promise of permanent memory. Her notebook records what she has encountered and what she wants to revisit, not a fixed judgment about her ability.
paragraphs.zh: 乔也比较相似单词，区分它们的用法。例句有助于加强联系，但她不把答对一次当作永久记住的保证。笔记记录的是她见过什么、希望重看什么，而不是对能力作出固定评判。

levels.title: The launch that got smaller
levels.word: priority · delegate · coordinate · feasible · constraint · deadline
levels.description: Six words, two kinds of practice, and one complete reading.

paragraphs.en: A student team plans to launch a website with twelve features in one month. Its priority seems to be doing everything at once. Then the team notices a constraint: only two members can write code, and both have exams before the deadline.
paragraphs.zh: 一个学生团队计划一个月内推出包含十二项功能的网站。他们似乎把所有事同时做完当作首要任务。后来团队意识到一项限制：只有两人会写代码，而两人都要在截止日期前参加考试。

paragraphs.en: The team reduces the first release to a search page and a clear sign-up process. This smaller plan is feasible with the time available. The leader learns to delegate writing and testing, rather than holding every decision personally. People can contribute without doing identical jobs.
paragraphs.zh: 团队将首版缩减为一个搜索页面和清晰的注册流程。以现有时间，这个较小的计划是可行的。负责人学会分配写作和测试任务，而非事事亲自作决定。人们不必做相同工作，也可以作出贡献。

paragraphs.en: To coordinate the work, the members agree on what each page must do before discussing its decoration. They review progress twice a week and move optional ideas to a later list. The launch is less elaborate than first imagined, but people can actually use it. Finishing a coherent smaller product is different from abandoning a larger one halfway through.
paragraphs.zh: 为协调工作，成员在讨论装饰前，先商定每个页面必须完成什么。他们每周检查两次进度，把可选想法放到后续清单。推出的版本没有最初设想那么繁复，却真正可用。完成一件完整的小产品，与把大产品做一半就搁置不同。

levels.title: When the system says no
levels.word: automate · assess · transparent · accountable · consent · override
levels.description: Six words, two kinds of practice, and one complete reading.

paragraphs.en: A community center uses software to automate room bookings. The system can assess whether a room is free, but it initially rejects requests with unfamiliar names. Staff members discover that the program treats a formatting difference as a reason to block a user.
paragraphs.zh: 一家社区中心用软件自动处理房间预订。系统可以判断房间是否空闲，但最初会拒绝一些包含不熟悉姓名的申请。工作人员发现，程序把格式差异当成了阻止用户的理由。

paragraphs.en: The center wants a more transparent process. It explains what information is checked and asks for consent before storing optional personal details. Users should not have to guess why they were rejected or provide unrelated information merely to reserve a table.
paragraphs.zh: 中心希望流程更透明，说明系统会检查哪些信息，并在保存非必要个人资料前征得同意。用户不应被迫猜测被拒的原因，也不该仅为预订一张桌子就提供无关信息。

paragraphs.en: A trained worker can override an incorrect rejection, while keeping a record of the reason. The software remains useful, but a named manager is accountable for how it is used. Calling a decision automatic does not remove the need for someone to explain and correct it.
paragraphs.zh: 受过培训的工作人员可以推翻错误拒绝，并记录理由。软件仍有用，但明确指定的经理要对其使用方式负责。称某项决定是自动作出的，并不能消除解释和纠正决定的责任。
